title: Herbal Irish Prosciutto Flatbread
description: A dense, earthy flatbread featuring the herbal notes of wild garlic and rosemary, paired with the salty sweetness of prosciutto, perfect for a monsoon-inspired Irish meal. This recipe is adapted for a shojin-friendly diet and served in an agave-leaf vessel.

ingredients.name: Agave-Leaf Vessel
ingredients.notes: Fresh, large enough to hold the flatbread

instructions: Combine wild garlic, yeast, and 1/2 cup warm water in a large mixing bowl, let sit for 10 minutes.
Add agave syrup, rosemary, salt, and flour to the bowl, mix until a shaggy dough forms.
Knead the dough on a floured surface for 10 minutes, until smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a lightly oiled bowl, cover with a damp cloth, and let rise in a warm place for 2 hours.
Preheat a dry griddle or skillet over medium-high heat, cook the flatbread for 2-3 minutes per side, until puffed and golden.
Meanwhile, slice the prosciutto into thin strips and place on a baking sheet, bake in a preheated oven at 200°F (90°C) for 5-7 minutes, until crispy.
Place the cooked flatbread on the agave-leaf vessel, top with crispy prosciutto and a drizzle of olive oil.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional wild garlic if desired.
Cut the flatbread into slices or wedges, serve with additional prosciutto and agave syrup if desired.
